# BondoMod v0.2.12

- Support reports compare expected, received and successfully forwarded cosmetic IDs by slot. Record initial delivery, later loadout corrections and forwarding errors.
- Distinguish historical match logs from recent evidence, with the time of the last recorded match and observation. A new app version alone does not prove that its spawner was tested.
- Fix false painted-item baseline warnings: painted inventory entries do not trigger a warning unless a painted instance was identified as equipped.
- Keep automatic failure detection active during long-running matches and reject stale contexts from an earlier spawner session.
- Send reports for match delivery errors using the existing bounded offline queue and retry limits.
- Use the app's diagnostic directory for standalone and combined spawner helpers, and record the diagnostic runtime revision.

This update improves diagnosis; the latest reported reset is not yet explained or confirmed fixed. Forwarded item IDs do not prove the game's rendered appearance. Owned RLCS / Esports decals may still reset spawned item colours after a goal.
